notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Famished Foragers.
Famished Foragers does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Famished Foragers and Hellkite Charger.
 An opponent has lost life this turn.
description:
Declare Famished Foragers as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger and Famished Foragers' myriad ability trigger.
Resolve the Famished Foragers trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Famished Foragers tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least nine {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Famished Foragers tokens.
Repeat each combat phase.
